metadata.title: The Lake That Released a Cloud of Carbon Dioxide
metadata.description:
Lake Nyos released a deadly cloud of carbon dioxide. The cause: limnic eruption of carbon dioxide dissolved in the lake's deep layers.

Failure chain: Volcanic CO2 seeps into Lake → Deep water saturates → Trigger upsets layers → Gas bursts out → Heavy cloud flows into valleys

Related episode: Wind-Driven Fire: What Destroyed Lahaina — https://youtu.be/tH-casKT7OY

Series — Natural Hazards vs. Engineering: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdrG62GTUxOM

• Wikipedia — Lake Nyos disaster — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lake_Nyos_disaster
